description: Product-level fragrance name candidates collected from public retailer and collection indexes for requested brands. This is a research overlay, not retailer offer data and not yet imported into the canonical database. Names are retained once per brand/name pair; variants, GTINs, prices, availability, and shipping are never inferred.

policy.games_of_spades_hierarchy: Games of Spades is the fragrance collection/brand label used in ScentHunter; Jo Milano Paris is the manufacturer. Gift sets/coffrets are excluded as separate canonical fragrances. Concentration variants such as Rouge Extrait are not separate canonical fragrance identities unless product model requires it.
policy.brand_line_hierarchy: Where the requested catalog line is distinct from the manufacturer, keep the requested line as brand/collection and store the parent house separately as manufacturer. Aromatix is cataloged as Aromatix, with French Avenue as manufacturer.
policy.games_of_spades_unverified_registry_entr: Jack remains in the family registry as a discovery-only/historical candidate, but is not imported into the canonical product seed because no current official Jo Milano Paris listing or product detail page was verified in this pass.
policy.pending_candidates: Bujairami Hectic and Arabiyat Prestige Mahd Al Dhahab Extrait remain discovery candidates only. Their retailer evidence is recorded, but neither was imported into the canonical seed because official brand-level identity evidence and/or concentration modeling is unresolved.
policy.bujairami_hectic: Hectic is now admitted as a source-verified canonical name from the official Bujairami product page. Concentration, volume and GTIN are not imported because the official detail page omits them and retailer sources conflict.
policy.mahd_al_dhahab_extrait: Confirmed as a distinct canonical fragrance identity from the EDP. MyPerfumes Europe official Arabiyat perfumes store product detail identifies Extrait de Parfum 60 ml. Do not merge into EDP identity.
